question: French legend Raymond Poulidor finished on the Tour de France podium eight times between 1962 and 1976. How many days did he spend in the yellow jersey?
question_short: Raymond Poulidor made the Tour de France podium 8 times. How many days in yellow?
answer_detail: "Poupou" was second three times and third five times but never led the Tour. His grandson Mathieu van der Poel finally took yellow for the family in 2021.
answer_short: Never led the Tour; grandson Mathieu van der Poel took yellow in 2021.
